status: Verified execution; scope-limited descriptive and relational audit, not full paper reproduction

sessions.parquet.schema:
session_id: string
user_id: string
harness: string
parent_session_id: string
spawned_by_step: int32
spawned_by_call_index: int32

requests.parquet.schema:
session_id: string
step: int32
link_reason: string
start_ms: int64
end_ms: int64
ttft_ms: int64
model: string
provider: string
stream: bool
step_trigger: string
waited_for: string
prompt_tokens: int64
completion_tokens: int64
cache_read_tokens: int64
role_tokens: struct<system: int64, user: int64, assistant: int64, tool: int64, tool_definitions: int64>
  child 0, system: int64
  child 1, user: int64
  child 2, assistant: int64
  child 3, tool: int64
  child 4, tool_definitions: int64
n_messages: int32
tool_definition_names: list<element: string>
  child 0, element: string
finish_reason: string
transition: string
cause: string
block_ids: large_list<element: int64>
  child 0, element: int64

tool_calls.parquet.schema:
session_id: string
step: int32
call_index: int32
name: string
category: string
programs: list<element: string>
  child 0, element: string
parse_status: string
arguments_skeleton: string
outcome: string
result_tokens: int64
latency_ms: int64

time.unit: milliseconds since Unix epoch; source-definition checked, scale observed

known_limits: Raw source events and physical timestamp meaning cannot be independently validated from public aggregates.
block_ids not read; their schema/footer byte sizes only were checked.
Arguments, program labels, raw tool names and tool definition strings were pruned; their semantic anonymity was not audited.
No semantic intent labels or wire packet/flow measurements exist in observed schema.
Week-local user hashes do not support unconditional cross-week unique-person counts.
Labels harness/tool-category/mutation are inferred/exported metadata, not independently labeled intent ground truth.
